name: Deadwood Tavern
address: 6 S Dubuque St, Iowa City, IA 52240
hours_note: Hours not published on source listing; confirm before going.
blurb: Pinball, a jukebox, cheap whiskey and zero pretension: the Deadwood is the dive every other Iowa City dive wishes it were.

name: Fieldhouse Bar
address: 138 S Clinton St, Iowa City, IA 52240
hours_note: Open daily; check website for current hours.
blurb: Two floors of Iowa City nightlife — game-day sports bar downstairs, dance floor and DJ upstairs. A go-to spot on Hawkeye game days and weekend nights.

name: Joe's Place
address: 115 Iowa Ave, Iowa City, IA 52240
hours_note: Hours not published on source listing.
blurb: Open since 1934 with three bars, 25-plus TVs, pool, darts and the town's first rooftop patio. It's a rite of passage.

name: The Dandy Lion
address: 111 S Dubuque St, Iowa City, IA 52240
hours_note: Breakfast and lunch served daily until 2 PM per listing.
blurb: Southern-leaning brunch, local coffee and real cocktails on the Ped Mall; the go-to when last night needs fixing.

name: Brothers Bar & Grill
address: 125 S Dubuque St Ste 4000, Iowa City, IA 52240
blurb: Big, loud and packed on game day; Brothers is where the undergrad energy peaks and the pitchers keep coming.

name: The Summit Restaurant & Bar
address: 10 S Clinton St, Iowa City, IA 52240
hours_note: Check current hours.
blurb: Multi-level Clinton Street staple with a rooftop, wings, and a dance floor that fills up fast on weekends.

name: Bo-James
address: 118 E Washington St, Iowa City, IA 52240
blurb: Burgers, beer and a sidewalk patio a block from the Ped Mall; Bo-James is the reliable pregame that turns into the night.

name: Sports Column
address: 12 S Dubuque St, Iowa City, IA 52240
blurb: Two floors of TVs and Hawkeye fans; the Column is chaos on Saturdays and honestly that's the appeal.

name: Micky's Irish Pub & Grill
address: 11 S Dubuque St, Iowa City, IA 52240
blurb: Dark wood, decent pub food and a patio that's perfect for people-watching Dubuque Street; a solid Irish standby.

name: Elray's Live & Dive
address: 211 Iowa Ave, Iowa City, IA 52240
hours_note: Confirm event calendar before going.
blurb: Country bands, cover bands, dance floor and a big rowdy crowd on Iowa Avenue; boots are optional but encouraged.

name: DC's Sports Bar
address: 124 S Dubuque St, Iowa City, IA 52240
hours_note: Mon–Fri 2pm–2am; Sat–Sun 11am–2am. Daily drink specials posted on social.
blurb: Big windows, big patio, wings and burgers under $12; DC's is the easy answer for a game-day lunch that never ends.

name: Coa Cantina
address: 18 1/2 S Clinton St, Iowa City, IA 52240
hours_note: Bar Mon–Wed 4pm–2am, Thu–Sat 11am–2am, Sun 8pm–2am; kitchen closes 9pm, closed Sun.
blurb: Two levels, three bars and 200-plus tequilas with a DJ on weekends; tacos early, margaritas late, regrets Sunday.

name: Studio 13
address: 13 S Linn St Ste 1, Iowa City, IA 52240
blurb: Iowa City's longtime LGBTQ+ club with drag shows, dancing and a welcoming crowd tucked down an alley off Linn Street.

name: Vue Rooftop
address: 328 S Clinton St, Iowa City, IA 52240
blurb: Cocktails twelve stories up atop the Hilton Garden Inn; skyline views, dressy-ish crowd, best at sunset.

name: Paper Crane
address: 121 N Linn St, Iowa City, IA 52240
blurb: Asian-inspired late-night bites and cocktails on the Northside; moody, a little fancy, and open when you need it.

name: St. Burch Tavern
address: 127 Iowa Ave, Iowa City, IA 52240
hours_note: Confirm address on listing.
blurb: Upscale tavern fare and a serious cocktail list on Iowa Avenue; where you take parents who are paying.

name: Pullman Bar & Diner
address: 17 S Dubuque St, Iowa City, IA 52240
hours_note: Listed in the 2025 Downtown Iowa City dining guide; confirm address.
blurb: Elevated diner food and stiff cocktails in a slick booth-lined room; the brunch line is long for a reason.

name: Brix Cheese Shop & Wine Bar
address: 209 N Linn St, Iowa City, IA 52245
hours_note: Confirm address.
blurb: Wine flights, cheese boards and a patio on the Northside; the chill date-night move when bars feel too loud.

name: The Stuffed Olive
address: 104 S Dubuque St, Iowa City, IA 52240
hours_note: Confirm address.
blurb: A martini menu longer than your reading list; sweet, boozy and the right call before a show at the Englert.

name: The Airliner
address: 22 S Clinton St, Iowa City, IA 52240
hours_note: Confirm address.
blurb: Across from the Pentacrest since 1944 with pizza, pitchers and a rooftop; it's a Hawkeye landmark for a reason.

name: Big Grove Brewery & Taproom
address: 1225 S Gilbert St, Iowa City, IA 52240
blurb: Massive beer garden, fire pits, lawn games and Easy Eddy on tap; Big Grove is a whole afternoon, not a stop.

name: ReUnion Brewery – Iowa City
address: 110 E College St, Iowa City, IA 52240
hours_note: Confirm address.
blurb: House beers and brewpub food right on the Ped Mall; a good middle ground between a dive and a dinner.

name: ReUnion Brewery – Coralville
address: 516 2nd St, Coralville, IA 52241
hours_note: On 2nd St in Coralville, a short drive from Iowa River Landing proper.
blurb: The Coralville sibling with the same beers, more parking and a calmer crowd; ideal for a weeknight pint.

name: Wildwood Smokehouse & Saloon
address: 4919 Walleye Dr SE, Iowa City, IA 52240
hours_note: South of town off Hwy 6, not walkable from downtown; active 2026 show calendar on Ticketmaster.
blurb: Country and rock acts, BBQ and a big dance floor out on the south edge of town; bring boots and a DD.

name: George's Buffet
address: 312 E Market St, Iowa City, IA 52245
blurb: A cash-friendly Northside dive with cheap beer and a legendary wax-paper cheeseburger; nothing has changed and nothing should.

name: Hamburg Inn No. 2
address: 214 N Linn St, Iowa City, IA 52245
blurb: The pie-shake diner where presidential candidates stop; greasy, historic and worth the weekend wait.

name: John's Grocery
address: 401 E Market St, Iowa City, IA 52245
hours_note: Retail beer and wine shop, not a bar; confirm current hours.
blurb: A corner grocery with one of the best beer selections in the Midwest; stock up before the party, not after.

name: Pagliai's Pizza
address: 302 E Bloomington St, Iowa City, IA 52245
blurb: Thin-crust, square-cut, sausage-heavy pizza since 1969; Pagliai's is the Northside's most-argued-about slice.

name: Bluebird Diner
address: 330 E Market St, Iowa City, IA 52245
hours_note: Confirm address.
blurb: Retro diner brunch with big portions and bigger coffee; the Northside's best hangover cure not named Hamburg Inn.

name: Oasis Falafel
address: 206 N Linn St, Iowa City, IA 52245
hours_note: Confirm address.
blurb: Fast, cheap, excellent falafel and shawarma on Linn Street; the smart move between afternoon beers and evening beers.

name: Trumpet Blossom Cafe
address: 310 E Prentiss St, Iowa City, IA 52240
hours_note: Confirm address.
blurb: All-vegan menu, craft cocktails and the occasional show; even committed carnivores leave impressed.

name: Basta Pizzeria Ristorante
address: 121 Iowa Ave, Iowa City, IA 52240
hours_note: Confirm address.
blurb: Wood-fired pizza and a patio on Iowa Avenue; nicer than a slice joint, cheaper than a steakhouse, just right.

name: The Webster
address: 202 N Linn St, Iowa City, IA 52245
hours_note: Confirm address.
blurb: Fine dining without stuffiness; tasting-menu energy and a bar worth sitting at on its own.

name: Formosa
address: 221 E College St, Iowa City, IA 52240
hours_note: Confirm address.
blurb: Sushi and cocktails in a dim, clubby room on College Street; the dinner that slides straight into going out.

name: Englert Theatre
address: 221 E Washington St, Iowa City, IA 52240
hours_note: Box office and show times vary; check englert.org.
blurb: A restored 1912 theater booking touring bands, comedians and Mission Creek; the crown jewel of downtown nightlife.

name: Gabe's

name: FilmScene

hours_note: Chauncey location; also a Ped Mall screen at 118 E College St. Check showtimes online.

name: Riverside Theatre
address: 119 E College St, Iowa City, IA 52240
hours_note: Confirm address on listing.
blurb: Professional theater on the Ped Mall doing new plays and Shakespeare; small room, big talent, cheap-ish tickets.

name: Hancher Auditorium
address: 141 E Park Rd, Iowa City, IA 52242
hours_note: On the UI campus north of downtown along the river.
blurb: The university's glass-walled riverside hall for Broadway tours, orchestras and the occasional big-name concert.

name: Stanley Museum of Art
address: 160 W Burlington St, Iowa City, IA 52242
hours_note: Free admission; confirm days and hours.
blurb: Free art museum with a Pollock mural the size of a wall; a good pre-drinks activity, no joke.

name: Prairie Lights
address: 15 S Dubuque St, Iowa City, IA 52240
hours_note: Frequent evening author readings.
blurb: Legendary indie bookstore with a cafe upstairs and author readings most weeks; UNESCO City of Literature cred.

name: 30hop
address: 900 E 2nd Ave, Coralville, IA 52241
hours_note: Mon–Thu 11am–10pm; Fri 11am–midnight; Sat 10am–midnight; Sun 10am–10pm.
blurb: Rooftop patio, a long tap list and comfort food with some flair; the anchor of Iowa River Landing nights.

name: Tribute Eatery & Bar
address: 901 E 2nd Ave Ste 100, Coralville, IA 52241
hours_note: Mon–Thu 11am–9pm; Fri 11am–10pm; Sat 9am–10pm; Sun 9am–9pm; brunch Sat–Sun 9am–3pm.
blurb: Chef-driven plates, wine and cocktails with a patio; the grown-up dinner spot in the Landing.

name: Iowa Athletic Club
address: 200 E 9th St, Coralville, IA 52241
hours_note: Sun–Thu 11am–9pm; Fri–Sat 11am–midnight.
blurb: Tavern pizza, wings and arcade games attached to Xtream Arena; a sports bar built for before and after the game.

name: Vesta
address: 849 Quarry Rd, Coralville, IA 52241
hours_note: Tue–Thu 3pm–9pm; Fri 3pm–10pm; Sat 11am–10pm; closed Sun–Mon per source.
blurb: Elevated comfort food and globally inspired plates with a patio; Vesta is the Landing's low-key gem.

name: Marquee Pizzeria
address: 920 E 2nd Ave, Coralville, IA 52241
hours_note: Sun–Thu 11am–9pm; Fri–Sat 11am–10pm.
blurb: Wood-fired pizza and homemade pasta in the Landing; easy, crowd-pleasing and fine for a pre-arena dinner.

name: Hokkaido Ramen House
address: 201 E 9th St, Coralville, IA 52241
hours_note: Mon–Sat 11:30am–9pm; Sun 11:30am–8:30pm.
blurb: Rich, proper ramen next to the arena; the warm bowl you want after a cold walk from the parking ramp.

name: Xtream Arena
address: 200 E 9th St, Coralville, IA 52241
hours_note: Event-based; check the arena calendar.
blurb: Concerts, Hawkeye volleyball and Heartlanders hockey in a 5,000-seat arena; the biggest indoor stage on the Iowa City end.

name: Pat & Fran's
address: 808 5th St Ste 8, Coralville, IA 52241
hours_note: On 5th Street in old Coralville, not inside Iowa River Landing proper.
blurb: Neighborhood bar and grill in old Coralville with TVs, burgers and regulars who will absolutely talk Hawkeye football.

name: Reds Alehouse
address: 405 N Dubuque St, North Liberty, IA 52317
hours_note: Hours not published on source listing.
blurb: 18 rotating taps, flatbreads and one of the area's best patios; the reason people in North Liberty stay in North Liberty.

name: Rayo Mexican Bar & Grill
address: North Liberty, IA
hours_note: Confirm address on the Think Iowa City listing.
blurb: Margaritas and big Mexican plates in North Liberty; the reliable group-dinner pick before a night out.

name: Bluebird Cafe – North Liberty
address: North Liberty, IA
hours_note: Confirm address on the Think Iowa City listing.
blurb: The North Liberty outpost of the Iowa City diner; same big breakfasts, shorter lines.

name: Club 76 The Lodge
address: North Liberty, IA
hours_note: Confirm address on the Think Iowa City listing.
blurb: Roadhouse-style bar and event space in North Liberty; expect bands, bikes and cheap domestics.

name: Twelve01 Kitchen and Tap
address: North Liberty, IA
hours_note: Confirm address on the Think Iowa City listing.
blurb: Craft taps and a polished kitchen menu; North Liberty's answer to a downtown gastropub without the parking fight.

name: Kinnick Stadium
address: 1 Kinnick Dr, Iowa City, IA 52242
hours_note: Event-based; check the Iowa Athletics calendar.
blurb: Home of the Iowa Hawkeyes, Kinnick's 69,250-seat bowl has hosted some of the biggest concert events to ever hit Iowa City.

name: Carver-Hawkeye Arena
address: Carver-Hawkeye Arena, Iowa City, IA 52242
hours_note: Event-based; check the Iowa Athletics and Venue calendar.
blurb: 15,500-seat arena on the UI campus hosting Hawkeye basketball, wrestling, and major touring concerts.
